name: Understanding what neural networks actually learn
gist: Papers analyze and measure the geometry of learned representations to understand how networks encode information, what patterns they capture, and whether they learn interpretable structure.
explain: A trained neural network is a black box: it takes data in and produces predictions, but what is it really capturing? Are the learned representations organized? Do they encode interpretable ideas? These questions matter because if you understand what a model has learned, you can diagnose failures, design better architectures, and predict when transfer to a new task will work. Papers in this subtheme are detective work: they develop tools and experiments to peer inside the model's learned representations.

The difficulty is that representations are high-dimensional (often hundreds or thousands of numbers per input), which is hard to visualize or analyze directly. Researchers use several techniques: they measure how similar the internal representations are for similar inputs, they project high-dimensional spaces down to 2D or 3D for visualization, they check whether you can linearly separate different categories in the learned space, they measure information content — how much of the input information has the model preserved or discarded. Some papers use adversarial perturbations to understand if small intentional changes break the model. Others analyze what individual neurons or layers are sensitive to. The results often reveal that models learn hierarchically: early layers capture textures and edges, middle layers capture parts, and late layers capture whole objects.

Across 64 papers, researchers explore what self-supervised models have learned, what makes representations good for transfer learning, how different pretraining methods produce different structural organizations, and whether interpretable features emerge naturally. This work is foundational for building intuition about why these methods work, and it often reveals surprising failures: models sometimes learn spurious shortcuts or miss important dimensions entirely. Understanding these patterns helps design better pretraining objectives because researchers can target the proxy tasks and architectures that naturally encourage the kinds of structure that downstream tasks need.

papers.title: A Bayesian Nonparametric Framework For Learning Disentangled Representations
papers.contribution: Addresses both identifiability guarantees and representation capacity trade-off through nonparametric formulation enabling sufficient latent capacity without violating structural constraints.

papers.title: Attention, Please! Revisiting Attentive Probing Through the Lens of Efficiency
papers.contribution: Consistent outperformance of linear and previous attentive probing methods across benchmarks with reduced parameters and emerging interpretable attention properties.

papers.title: Beyond DAGs: A Latent Partial Causal Model for Multimodal Learning
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that MMCL learns disentangled representations enabling few-shot learning and improved domain generalization, deepening understanding of why MMCL works for multimodal learning.

papers.title: Disentangled representation learning through unsupervised symmetry group discovery
papers.contribution: The approach outperforms existing Linear Symmetry-Based Disentangled (LSBD) methods on three environments with different group decompositions.

papers.title: Domain Expansion: A Latent Space Construction Framework for Multi-Task Learning
papers.contribution: The framework prevents latent representation collapse and yields an explicit, interpretable, and compositional latent space where concepts can be directly manipulated.

papers.title: Embedding-Based Context-Aware Reranker
papers.contribution: EBCAR demonstrates effectiveness for information retrieval requiring cross-passage inference while achieving advantages in both accuracy and efficiency compared to state-of-the-art rerankers.

papers.title: From Vicious to Virtuous Cycles: Synergistic Representation Learning for Unsupervised Video Object-Centric Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art results on challenging video object-centric learning benchmarks by breaking the encoder-decoder representational gap.

papers.title: Learning Unified Representation of 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.contribution: Enables more principled representation preserving color and geometric structure, benefiting downstream learning and neural network-based 3DGS applications.

papers.title: Mechanistic Independence: A Principle for Identifiable Disentangled Representations
papers.contribution: These criteria yield identifiability of latent subspaces even under nonlinear, non-invertible mixing, and establish a hierarchy among criteria with graph-theoretic characterization of latent factors.

papers.title: Spatially Informed Autoencoders for Interpretable Visual Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Improves classification accuracy of attractive, repulsive, and uncorrelated point patterns from 48% (VAE) to over 80% in worst case and 90% in best case, enabling zero-shot conditional simulation from images.

papers.title: Uncertainty-driven Embedding Convolution
papers.contribution: UEC consistently improves both performance and robustness across diverse benchmarks by combining principled uncertainty modeling with ensemble learning.

papers.title: $\mathbb{R}^{2k}$ is Theoretically Large Enough for Embedding-based Top-$k$ Retrieval
papers.contribution: Shows MED is Θ(k) for inner product, Euclidean distance, and cosine similarity; derives robust MED feasibility ceiling and validates with experiments.

papers.title: Behavioral Embeddings of Programs: A Quasi-Dynamic Approach for Optimization Prediction
papers.contribution: PQ-BERT outperforms baselines on Best Pass Prediction and -Oz Benefit Prediction compiler tasks, transcending the static-dynamic representation trade-off.

papers.title: Boosting Open Set Recognition Performance through Modulated Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Temperature schedules boost both open set and closed set recognition performance with no computational overhead across multiple OSR loss functions.

papers.title: Compositional Generalization Requires Linear, Orthogonal Representations in Vision Embedding Models
papers.contribution: Shows the Linear Representation Hypothesis is a necessary consequence of compositional generalization, and empirically confirms partial linear factorization with low-rank near-orthogonal factors across CLIP, SigLIP, and DINO.

papers.title: Convergent World Representations and Divergent Tasks
papers.contribution: Show multi-task training drives convergent world representations while some divergent tasks harm new entity integration via fine-tuning.

papers.title: DDSVM: A Differentiable Framework for Deep Support Vector Machines with Iterative Geometry-Aware Optimization
papers.contribution: Reduces top-1 error by 5.6-8.3% on image classification benchmarks under data scarcity.

papers.title: Distributionally Robust Set Representation Learning Under Inference-Time Element Corruption
papers.contribution: Effectively enhances robustness against corruption across four tasks while maintaining high overall performance.

papers.title: Efficient Code Analysis via Graph Representation Learning-Guided Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms existing approaches on multiple datasets while reducing interference from irrelevant context and maintaining low annotation costs.

papers.title: Estimating Dimensionality of Neural Representations from Finite Samples
papers.contribution: The estimator recovers true known dimensionality on synthetic data and remains invariant to sample size on neural recordings, brain imaging, and LLM activations.

papers.title: Explaining Concept Shift with Interpretable Feature Attribution
papers.contribution: SGShift identifies shifted features much more accurately than baselines, requires few samples in the shifted domain, and is robust to complex cases of concept shift in tabular data.

papers.title: Frequency-Balanced Retinal Representation Learning with Mutual Information Regularization
papers.contribution: Learns frequency-balanced features surpassing MAE-based retinal encoders in quantitative and qualitative evaluations without architecture changes.

papers.title: From Extrinsic to Intrinsic: Geodesic-Guided Representation Learning for 3D Geometric Data
papers.contribution: Demonstrates satisfactory accuracy, robustness, and efficiency in geodesic prediction with superior performance across shape recognition, surface parameterization, and non-rigid correspondence.

papers.title: GRACE: Generative Representation Learning via Contrastive Policy Optimization
papers.contribution: GRACE yields 11.5% supervised and 6.9% unsupervised performance improvement on MTEB benchmark across backbones while preserving capabilities and providing transparent reasoning traces.

papers.title: GUIDE: Gated Uncertainty-Informed Disentangled Experts for Long-tailed Recognition
papers.contribution: Establishes new state-of-the-art on five challenging LTR benchmarks including ImageNet-LT and iNaturalist 2018.

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Probabilistic Circuits via Voronoi Tessellations
papers.contribution: Voronoi tessellations enable geometry-aware probabilistic circuits with either bounded approximate inference or exact tractable inference, validated on standard density estimation tasks.

papers.title: HypRAG: Hyperbolic Dense Retrieval for Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.contribution: On MTEB and RAGBench, HyTE-FH outperforms Euclidean baselines while HyTE-H achieves up to 29% gains in context relevance and answer relevance with smaller models than state-of-the-art retrievers.

papers.title: In Context Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: Shows Transformers can leverage unlabeled context to improve performance in low-label regimes, providing foundational insights into ICL representation learning.

papers.title: Is the Reversal Curse a Binding Problem? Uncovering Limitations of Transformers from a Basic Generalization Failure
papers.contribution: First model to break Reversal Curse without data augmentation or non-causal masking, with further improvements possible via special memory layers.

papers.title: Joint Learning in the Gaussian Single Index Model
papers.contribution: Proves convergence under relaxed conditions with rate controlled by information exponent; convergence occurs even when initial direction is negatively correlated with target.

papers.title: LLM-JEPA: Large Language Models Meet Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures
papers.contribution: Outperforms standard LLM training objectives across multiple models (Llama3, OpenELM, Gemma2, Olmo) and datasets while being robust to overfitting.

papers.title: LLM-based Embeddings: Attention Values Encode Sentence Semantics Better Than Hidden States
papers.contribution: AlignedWVA achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free LLM-based embeddings, outperforming the high-cost MetaEOL by a substantial margin.

papers.title: LORE: Jointly Learning The Intrinsic Dimensionality and Relative Similarity Structure from Ordinal Data
papers.contribution: LORE recovers compact, interpretable low-dimensional embeddings of subjective percepts and automatically infers intrinsic dimensionality from crowdsourced ordinal judgments.

papers.title: Learning Explicit Single-Cell Dynamics Using ODE Representations
papers.contribution: Cell-MNN achieves competitive performance on benchmarks, surpasses baselines in scaling to larger datasets and joint training, while learning interpretable gene interactions validated against TRRUST.

papers.title: Learning Fingerprints for Medical Time Series with Redundancy-Constrained Information Maximization
papers.contribution: Produces low-dimensional, interpretable, sample-efficient representations where each token captures independent factors of variation, paving the way for more robust digital biomarkers.

papers.title: Learning Molecular Semantic Invariant Representation with Prototype Constraint
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines on molecular OOD benchmarks across diverse distribution shifts.

papers.title: Learning Robust Intervention Representations with Delta Embeddings
papers.contribution: Significantly exceeds baseline performance in OOD settings on Causal Triplet challenge for both synthetic and real-world benchmarks.

papers.title: Linear Causal Representation Learning by Topological Ordering, Pruning, and Disentanglement
papers.contribution: Demonstrates superiority over competing methods in finite samples and interpretability analysis of language models, integrating causality into AI understanding.

papers.title: Localized, High-resolution Geographic Representations with Slepian Functions
papers.contribution: Slepian encodings outperform baselines on five tasks (classification, regression, image-augmented prediction) while retaining pole-safety and spherical-distance preservation.

papers.title: Measuring the Intrinsic Dimension of Earth Representations
papers.contribution: Shows intrinsic dimensions fall between 2-10 for ambient dimensions 256-512, correlate with task performance, and enable unsupervised model evaluation.

papers.title: MedGMAE: Gaussian Masked Autoencoders for Medical Volumetric Representation Learning
papers.contribution: Outperforms traditional MAE baselines on downstream segmentation, classification, and registration tasks, enabling faster 3D CT volume reconstruction.

papers.title: Multi-ReduNet: Interpretable Class-Wise Decomposition of ReduNet
papers.contribution: Achieves superior efficiency and discriminative power under limited supervision while retaining interpretability.

papers.title: Multiview Self-Representation Learning across Heterogeneous Views
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches with theoretical analysis of assignment distribution consistency and incremental views.

papers.title: On the Optimization Trajectory of DeepWalk Embeddings
papers.contribution: First analysis of DeepWalk optimization trajectory with negative sampling on non-trivial graph classes; shows cluster structure recovery on Stochastic Block Models with separation conditions.

papers.title: On the Theoretical Limitations of Embedding-Based Retrieval
papers.contribution: Creates LIMIT dataset that stress tests models, showing state-of-the-art models fail despite simple nature of task, demonstrating limits of single vector paradigm.

papers.title: One Coin Has Two Sides: Single Poistive Multi Label Learning from Salient Annotations
papers.contribution: Theoretically shows SalSPML is harder than random SPML and demonstrates consistent improvements with average mAP gain of 3.16% on multiple benchmarks.

papers.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to ~19 points improvement in top-K retrieval and ~60% reduction in mean rank over baselines across taxonomy expansion tasks.

papers.title: Quasi-Monte Carlo Methods Enable Extremely Low-Dimensional Deep Generative Models
papers.contribution: QLVMs consistently outperform VAEs and IWAEs with matched latent dimensionality, enabling nonparametric density estimation, clustering, and geodesic path computation in interpretable low-dimensional spaces.

papers.title: Relevance-Based Embeddings: Lightweight Candidate Retrieval via Heavy-Ranker Calls
papers.contribution: Demonstrates power of relevance-based embeddings on diverse academic and production datasets for improved candidate retrieval.

papers.title: SWERank: Software Issue Localization with Code Ranking
papers.contribution: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on SWE-Bench-Lite and LocBench, outperforming both ranking models and costly agent-based systems using closed-source LLMs.

papers.title: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
papers.contribution: Framework is interpretable, robust, computationally efficient; establishes equivalence to local neighborhood alignment via Mutual Nearest Neighbors.

papers.title: Selective Rotary Position Embedding
papers.contribution: Selective RoPE improves language modeling and difficult sequence tasks like copying and retrieval in gated transformers and state-space models.

papers.title: Separating Representation from Reconstruction Enables Scalable Text Encoders
papers.contribution: Demonstrates monotonic scaling and superior performance on MTEB and frozen GLUE benchmarks, with 1.5-2x throughput gains and 2x sample efficiency improvements.

papers.title: TRIDENT: Cross-Domain Trajectory Spatio-Temporal Representation via Distance-Preserving Triplet Learning
papers.contribution: Outperforms strong baselines in retrieval accuracy, efficiency, cross-domain generalization, and enables tactical analysis of sports via silhouette-guided clustering.

papers.title: The Hippocampal Place Field Gradient: A Bio-inspired Framework Building Multiscale Representation for Better Sample Efficiency
papers.contribution: HiPE demonstrates effective data efficiency improvements, establishing a link between neural connectivity, activity patterns, and learning.

papers.title: Token Distillation: Attention-Aware Input Embeddings for New Tokens
papers.contribution: Token Distillation outperforms strong baselines across a wide range of open-weight models for new token embedding initialization.

papers.title: UME-R1: Exploring Reasoning-Driven Generative Multimodal Embeddings
papers.contribution: Significantly outperforms conventional discriminative embeddings on MMEB-V2 benchmark across 78 video, image, and visual document tasks, with oracle performance far exceeding either embedding type alone.

papers.title: Uncovering the Latent Potential of Deep Intermediate Representations
papers.contribution: LOES consistently outperforms standard baselines with gains increasing as model depth increases, enabling cross-lingual and cross-modal interpretability analyses.

papers.title: Unmute the Patch Tokens: Rethinking Probing in Multi-Label Audio Classification
papers.contribution: Binarized prototypical probes notably outperform linear and attentive probing across 13 datasets and 6 spectrogram-based encoders, establishing probing as competitive with fine-tuning for audio SSL model evaluation.

papers.title: Unveiling the Role of Data Uncertainty in Tabular Deep Learning
papers.contribution: Provides a unifying framework for understanding tabular methods and designs a novel numerical feature embedding method based on these insights.

papers.title: VJEPA: Variational Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures as Probabilistic World Models
papers.contribution: VJEPA-family objectives are more robust to high-variance distractors than reconstruction-based baselines on Noisy-TV, nonlinear, and image-based benchmarks.

papers.title: Var-JEPA: A Variational Formulation of the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture – Bridging Predictive and Generative Self-Supervised Lear
papers.contribution: Yields meaningful representations without ad-hoc anti-collapse regularizers and enables principled uncertainty quantification while improving downstream performance on tabular benchmarks.

papers.title: Variational Learning of Disentangled Representations
papers.contribution: Achieves stronger disentanglement than prior approaches across synthetic, image, and single-cell RNA-seq datasets.

papers.title: nD-RoPE: A Generalized RoPE for n-Dimensional Position Embedding
papers.contribution: Demonstrates consistent performance gains and improved generalization on images, videos, and point clouds with symmetric, directionally balanced second-order response.
